published_machine.gas: Argon selected from published compatible gases
published_machine.dimensional_scope: Nominal envelope excluding screw holes and rounded corners; plate thickness and usable margins require confirmation

published_research_recipe.scope: Experimental recipe from a research paper on this machine, not a supplier-qualified fan production recipe

study_assumptions.support_model: Homogenized vertical columns below the first part voxel in each XY column, perfectly attached to an isothermal plate; not industrial supports
study_assumptions.source_model: Laser energy averaged over each macro-layer and its scan/recoat duration; no resolved beam or melt pool

material_model.scope: Reuse the existing ORNL-based material_fields helper at plate temperature; constant solid properties for a coarse bulk thermal screen, not a calibrated machine material card
